regions.merged_text: Baby John Riddmann - 8 mo. - very strange threatening blood-tuomer, birth-mark Drs. fear to touch it. Father a convert goes to com- munion 4 or 5 times a yr. They promise more frequent ... Sept. 25 Thank God! Baby decidedly improved; nor at all so restless when mother asks if he sould be taken to Dr. again.
